skill_friction: Step 5 lists 'an ambiguous set of components to delete' as an Ask case, but also says intent answered by the org's semantics is decided. Here 'Transaction object' matched Transaction__c by exact label and Loyalty_Transaction__c by keyword; AskCoworker marked the ambiguity blocking. The skill does not say whether an exact label match counts as resolving delete-set ambiguity; I decided without asking.

Rule 3's AskCoworker wrong-claim counter does not say whether wrong platform claims attached to proposals (e.g. 'layouts must be deleted before the object', 'custom objects cannot be undeleted') count the same as wrong facts; counting them reached four and allowed skipping T.

Inventory rules say one row per deployable component, but for a CustomObject delete it is unclear whether cascaded children (fields, layout) need their own Delete rows; I folded them into the object row as documented cascade behavior.
No guidance on how to treat access grants in managed/platform permission sets for a Delete (they are auto-removed by the object delete); the Access rules only cover exclusive-access cases.
The RUNNER says to use {out}/.tmp for scratch files, but org-verification.md says design/.tmp/; followed the eval note.
